Title: The airframe and flight controls
Notes: Sim: from a parking spot with the engine off, check the outside view shows the ailerons, elevator and rudder moving with the controls, and that the flaps move with the battery on.

Title: The cockpit: G1000 PFD and MFD
Notes: Sim: check the PFD bezel labels the dual knob CRS/BARO and the outer ring changes the BARO box; check where NRST lives (PFD softkey or MFD page) and that the EIS strip shows RPM, fuel flow, oil pressure/temperature, fuel quantity, volts and amps.

Title: Engine, fuel and electrical systems
Notes: Sim: confirm both Skyhawk variants are fuel injected (no carb heat knob). If the classic variant has carb heat, add Classic panel callouts here and in L4.3. Check the fuel selector shows LEFT, BOTH, RIGHT and a separate fuel shutoff valve.

Title: Speeds, limits and checklists
Notes: Sim: compare the EFB checklist speeds with the POH speeds in the lesson (rotate 55, climb 70-80 then 74, approach 65-75/60-70, go-around 60). Check whether the EFB checklist can auto-complete items or highlight controls, and where that option is set; then update the 'in-sim checklist' section and its sim callout.

Title: Cockpit scavenger hunt
Notes: Sim: record the parking spot name for the FBO ramp (northwest apron) in the flight setup; confirm cockpit tooltips name each control; confirm all 16 items can be found and operated cold and dark (flaps need the battery) and that the transponder shows an ALT mode.

Title: Four forces and how a wing works
Notes: No sim instructions. Run 54.4: check the angle-of-attack widget and the Go deeper links.

Title: Attitude flying and trim
Notes: Sim: add the level-cruise sight picture screenshot from the default cockpit camera (49.5); confirm 2,300 RPM gives about 100-105 KIAS level at 3,500 ft at LOAD_SOLO; check the trim buttons move in steps as the sim callout says.

Title: Climbs and descents
Notes: Sim: fly a 500 fpm descent at 90 KIAS and note the RPM; adjust the 1,700-2,000 RPM range here and in C2.2 if it differs. Check the level-off lead (10% of VS) works in the sim.

Title: Turns and coordination
Notes: Sim: confirm the PFD turn-rate arc has standard-rate marks and the trend line reaches them at about 17 degrees of bank at 100 KTAS; check the slip/skid bar behaves as described with auto-rudder off.

Title: Straight and level
Notes: Sim: confirm an air start 5 nm east of KLVK at 3,500 ft heading 090 at 100 KIAS can be set (or use the fallback); time it; fly it fast once to check the airspeed tiers.

Title: Climbs and descents
Notes: Sim: confirm the air start; check 1,700-2,000 RPM gives the 90 KIAS descent; time it.

Title: Turns to headings
Notes: Sim: confirm the air start 3 nm north of KLVK (just inside the Class D, ATC off); time it.

Title: The box
Notes: Sim: confirm the air start and the WX_LIGHT_W winds aloft; check four 2-minute legs fit the valley; time it.

Title: Preflight and engine start
Notes: Sim: describe the walkaround mode (which items are modeled: pitot cover, chocks, tie-downs, fuel sampling); confirm the POH start sequence works (mixture idle cut-off, prime with the aux pump, START, mixture rich) and whether priming does anything; confirm oil pressure rises within 30-60 s.

Title: Taxiing, signs and markings
Notes: Sim: taxi from the FBO parking spot to the 25R run-up area via taxiway A and confirm the signs and markings match the FAA diagram (Oct 2026); then write the exact taxiway sequence into the lesson and C3.2. Confirm the taxi ribbon option name and the groundspeed readout.

Title: Run-up, before takeoff, and after landing
Notes: Sim: run-up at 1,800 RPM shows a magneto drop within POH limits (150/50); confirm the XPDR softkey mode names after landing (real NXi: GND, STBY, ON, ALT).

Title: Cold and dark to running
Notes: Sim: parking spot name for the northwest apron; name of the checklist auto-complete setting; the engine starts with the POH sequence; time it.

Title: Taxi to the runway at KLVK
Notes: Sim: parking spot and runway names; the route A to the 25R run-up pad matches the diagram; time it.

Title: Run-up
Notes: Sim: whether a run-up area start spot exists for 25R (otherwise continue from C3.2); time it.

Title: After landing and shutdown
Notes: Sim: runway name; XPDR softkey mode names; time it.

Title: Normal takeoff and climb
Notes: Sim: lined-up sight picture screenshot from the default cockpit camera (49.5); confirm the takeoff roll needs right rudder with auto-rudder off.

Title: The traffic pattern
Notes: Sim: fly the downwind/base/final table settings at C4.2's weight and adjust (8.5); confirm the sim's ATC and AI traffic use right traffic for KLVK 25R and left traffic at Tracy; check the traffic-pattern widget.

Title: Normal approach and landing
Notes: Sim: check PAPIs are shown at KLVK 7L and 25R and all four Tracy ends and read correctly on a 3 degree path; check the flare camera advice; add a screenshot if useful.

Title: Go-arounds
Notes: Sim: compare the EFB balked-landing checklist with the POH sequence in the lesson; check the sim climbs at 60 KIAS with flaps 20.

Title: Normal takeoff and departure
Notes: Sim: runway name; with ATC off, confirm a 45 degree right turn from the 25R upwind at 1,400 ft is sensible; time it.

Title: Fly the pattern
Notes: Sim: runway in use for the WX_LIGHT_W wind; pattern altitude about 1,000 ft MSL; time it.

Title: Full-stop landing
Notes: Sim: runway name; right pattern for 25R; time it; fly it fast once to check the tiers.

Title: Go-around
Notes: Sim: runway name; check the side-step direction works for a right-hand pattern; time it.

Title: Three-circuit session
Notes: Sim: runway in use; touch-and-go sequence (flaps up before full power); time three circuits.

Title: Slow flight
Notes: Sim: RPM that holds 55 KIAS with full flaps at C5.1's weight and altitude (lesson says about 1,900-2,100); check when the sim's stall horn sounds in that configuration.

Title: Stalls: power-off and power-on
Notes: Sim: check the stall cues (horn, camera shake, nose drop) in both configurations and adjust the sim callout; check full power with flaps 10 gives a clean power-on stall with the ball centered.

Title: Steep turns and load factor
Notes: Sim: check about 100-200 RPM extra holds 95 KIAS in a 45 degree turn and whether the sim shows an overbanking tendency.

Title: Engine failure and forced landings
Notes: Sim: glide about 4.5 nm from 3,000 ft AGL at 68 KIAS; the failure menu's engine-failure options (menu names); mixture cut-off stops the engine and mixture rich plus power restarts it.

Title: Slow flight
Notes: Sim: air start; slow-flight RPM; stall horn tiers; time it.

Title: Power-off stall
Notes: Sim: air start; full-stall behaviour and altitude lost; time it.

Title: Power-on stall
Notes: Sim: air start; wing-drop behaviour at full power; time it.

Title: Steep turns
Notes: Sim: air start 5 nm east of KLVK; confirm heading 310 points at Mt Diablo from there; time it.

Title: Engine failure
Notes: Sim: air start 8 nm east heading 270 at 110 KIAS (changed from 090 so KLVK can be in glide range when the failure comes late; D-22 style change to confirm); mixture cut-off kills the engine and a late restart works; time it.

Title: Reading a sectional chart
Notes: Sim: check the EFB map statement (it shows less than a sectional); no other sim items.

Title: Airspace
Notes: No sim items. The cross-section data was rebuilt from FAA airspace data (PR #42) and the VFR minimums match 14 CFR 91.155.

Title: Pilotage and dead reckoning
Notes: Sim: check I-580, the Altamont wind farms (may be missing) and the town of Tracy are recognisable from 3,500 ft.

Title: VOR navigation
Notes: Sim: how the G1000 shows the decoded VOR identifier and how to hear the Morse ID (audio panel NAV1); confirm the Manteca VOR (ECA 116.0) is in the sim's database.

Title: GPS navigation with the G1000
Notes: Sim: FPL page steps and the Activate Flight Plan menu wording; how a world-map flight plan syncs into the G1000; where NRST is.

Title: Planning a cross-country flight
Notes: No sim items. The nav log was recomputed from the FAA airport coordinates (KLVK-C83 049/12, C83-KTCY 134/12, KTCY-KLVK 271/18).

Title: Landmark hunt
Notes: Sim: runway name; visibility of the six landmarks; time it.

Title: Pilotage to Tracy
Notes: Sim: runway name; the California Aqueduct is visible; time it.

Title: Dead reckoning to Half Moon Bay
Notes: Sim: runway in use at KPAO; the 2,500 then 3,500 ft plan works with the sim scenery (ridge height); Crystal Springs Reservoir visible; KHAF CTAF 122.8; time it.

Title: VOR tracking
Notes: Sim: ECA at 116.0 exists; air start 10 nm south of it at 3,500 ft; time it.

Title: G1000 flight plan
Notes: Sim: FPL entry steps, D-> and NRST behaviour match the lesson; time it.

Title: Radio basics and the phonetic alphabet
Notes: Sim: check the ATC menu reads your calls aloud as described and the COM flip-flop key swaps frequencies.

Title: Non-towered airports (CTAF)
Notes: Sim: which CTAF calls the ATC window offers at Tracy; whether AI traffic announces its position; Tracy CTAF shows 123.075 in the sim.

Title: Towered airports and sim ATC
Notes: Sim: ATC window options for a VFR departure and arrival at Livermore; the frequencies and runway names sim ATC uses; what it calls the parking area; note differences from the scripts.

Title: CTAF pattern at Tracy
Notes: Sim: Tracy CTAF 123.075 in the sim; AI traffic appears; time it.

Title: Towered departure and return at Livermore
Notes: Sim: the full ATC sequence works with sim ATC and AI traffic on; time it.

Title: Aircraft data (specs, V-speeds, arcs, limits, power, performance)
Notes: 2026-10-09: specs, V-speeds, arcs and limits checked against the 172S NAV III POH (172SPHBUS-00). Sim: compare each V-speed with the EFB checklist; check the airspeed tape bands are 40-85 white, 48-129 green, 129-163 yellow, 163 red; record the exact variant names from the aircraft list; fly the power settings (Section 8.5) and the W5 pitch/power table.

Title: Airports (13)
Notes: 2026-10-09: elevations, runways, patterns, pattern altitudes and frequencies filled from the Chart Supplement (effective 2026-10-01) and the FAA airport diagrams. Sim: check KLVK tower 118.1, ground 121.6, ATIS 119.65; KTCY CTAF 123.075; C83 CTAF 123.05; KHAF CTAF 122.8; KPAO tower 118.6; check the sim's ATC uses right traffic for KLVK 25R; note the sim's parking spot names (the FBO is on the northwest apron at KLVK).

Title: Checklists (16)
Notes: 2026-10-09: every number and sequence checked against the POH, Sections 3 and 4. Sim: compare each checklist with the EFB checklist; confirm the start sequence (mixture idle cut-off, prime with the aux pump, START, mixture rich) works and whether priming is modeled; confirm the XPDR softkeys read STBY, ON, ALT, GND.

Title: Challenge presets (start states, weather, loads)
Notes: Sim: confirm the cold-and-dark option name in the flight setup and that each weather preset (clouds, wind, gusts, visibility, altimeter) can be set as written.

Title: W11 airspace cross-section
Notes: 2026-10-09: rebuilt from the FAA Class Airspace dataset sampled every 1 nm along the line (Class B shelves, Oakland Class C, Hayward and Livermore Class D). Not sim-dependent; glance at the SF TAC if you want a second look.
